events.context: Initial table on hydrocortisone use cases: save for red itchy bites/ivy/eczema on arm/leg/hand/body, avoid face/acne/leftover hurt; recommend Kao's Curel for 2 weeks or dermatologist for nerve-calming cream
User provides ingredient list for product with water, glycerin, 1,2-pentanediol, hydrogenated lecithin, ceramide NS/NG, phytosterols, stearic acid, shikonin, echinacea extract, trace patchouli oil
Expert praises product as excellent for leftover hurt from acne due to barrier repair (ceramides, phytosterols), nerve calming (shikonin), hydration; warns about trace patchouli oil
User asks about Kao's Curel (珂润轻龄弹润抗皱乳霜) anti-aging wrinkle cream

Expert rejects anti-aging Curel due to phenoxyethanol, blue gum eucalyptus, BHT, succinic acid, sodium hydroxide, ginger extract causing sting; recommends Intensive Moisture Facial Cream (dark blue jar)
User shows another Curel: 珂润轻龄弹润舒缓修护乳霜 / Soothing Repair Cream
Expert says safer than anti-aging but risky due to phenoxyethanol; good squalane/allantoin; recommends patch test; ranks products, prefers original ceramide product
User confirms 'That patchouli one right?'
Expert confirms patchouli ceramide formula as best; patch test; compares all products
User asks 'How can ceramide make your skin not pain?'
Expert explains ceramides rebuild skin barrier (brick wall analogy), protect nerve endings, timeline for relief
User shares mom's leftover cream ingredients starting with Aqua/Water, including squalane, shea butter, centella, fragrances like linalool/limonene
First response rejects due to parfum, linalool, limonene, citral etc., sodium hydroxide, citric acid, sea water
User repeats mom's cream ingredients (slightly varied list)
Second rejection emphasizes fragrance, citric acid, sodium hydroxide, sea water, plant extracts
User repeats mom's cream ingredients third time (list without some fragrances)
Third response endorses as excellent (#1 rank) due to centella, squalane, shea/mango butters for barrier/nerve calming; low risk citric acid/sea water; usage instructions, expectations
User asks 'Which one is probably the priciest ingredients?' about mom's cream
Expert ranks priciest in mom's cream: 1. Centella, 2. Eperua Falcata, 3. Cistus Incanus (incomplete)
User asks 'Which formula is probably the priciest, purely ingredient wise?'
Expert ranks formulas by raw ingredient cost: 1. Patchouli ceramide (ceramides/shikonin), 2. Mom's cream (centella/squalane), 3. Curel Soothing, 4. Curel Anti-aging; detailed breakdowns
